name: @workspace/quickfire-core
//: Platform-neutral half of the quickfire overlay (quickfire-overlay-spec). The root entry is pure model + palette projection + the built-in slate definitions; ./transcript and ./session are split out so the desktop overlay surface bundle never pulls the channel client in behind a type import.
//peerDependencies: ./session uses React hooks but this package owns no instance: the consuming app does. The desktop shell provides 19.2.4 (matched to its react-dom) and apps/mobile provides 19.0.0, forced by the react-native renderer inside the installed APK. The range says exactly that -- any React 19 -- and the build holds each consumer's own version to it.
